limitations: Development comparison on one previously inspected trajectory, not a blinded human benchmark or independent generalization test. Reviewers inspected two-view start/middle/end sheets before scoring their assigned variant; root reviewed key evidence. Adjacent chunks are correlated. No rating or reference fact was passed to the VLM.

rating_definitions.A: Substantially correct and informative about visible action, object and interaction; tolerates tiny movements described as stationary.
rating_definitions.P: Partly correct or generic; omits meaningful motion/state but does not make a major unsupported event claim.
rating_definitions.W: Clearly wrong object/action/contact claim, invented interaction, or explicit denial of clear movement.

protocol.output_scope: Current chunk only, at most 40 English words; 128 new-token limit.
protocol.context_dual: Both cameras, all original observations from max(0, end-40) through end; no future frames.
protocol.video_main: Main camera only, all original observations from start through end.
protocol.changes: Only diagnostic execution scope was extended; model, preprocessing, prompt and decoding unchanged.

critical_action_ranges.description: Gripper withdraws while bowl remains on stove.

notes.context_dual: A gains concentrate on stable supported-bowl states (256–352), plus correct wrist movement without bowl displacement at 360–368. Lift/transport still often called static on table; release omitted. 464 incorrectly says task has not begun; 480/488 incorrectly say black bowl absent.
notes.video_main: All A ratings are initial and final near-static windows (0–16 and 416–500). Clear lift and release still missed; many unsupported holding claims after release. P at 56, 104, 168 avoids overclaiming contact or small movement.
notes.boundary_handling: Do not use occluded contact at 56–80 or 192–216 as exact grasp/release truth; no hard keyframe localization scored.
